mechanics.claim: Gragas channels for 0.75 seconds before gaining damage reduction.
mechanics.quote: channels for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, drinking out of his brew, and gains damage reduction for {{fd|2.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Damage reduction lasts 2.5 seconds after the channel completes.
Upon completing the channel, the next basic attack within 5 seconds is empowered to deal bonus magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next [[basic attack]] within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the target and nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's damage is reduced to 50% against structures.
The target's-maximum-health portion of the empowered attack's damage is capped at 300 against monsters.
mechanics.quote: The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: The enhanced attack applies other on-hit effects and can critically strike as normal.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will apply other [[on-hit effect]]s and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
